title: Garden and Choir Again
author: Marguerite Brightwater
blurb: Astrid Halloran, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
